source_level_expression_B_large_vs_B_sma.note: B-large wins all 9 fixed sources with B-small field/meta/no_change failures; B-small wins v07 by preserving 潮汐簿; remaining ties, including t24/v20 where both fail differently

conclusion: B-large fixed multi groups have no B-only loss; regression retains 2 confirmed B-only losses (t24 f2, v20 f2). v07 is withdrawn after full-context review: 潮汐簿 is the only visible item with a cover, so the owner is uniquely recoverable; the plan asked for name, so it is plan-compliance/expression, not fact safety. Safety gate fails 2/19. B-large expression beats A-large 17/2 on multi groups and has no single-group regression. B-small is much worse on fixed (9/15 bad), but preserves the explicit owner in v07; it also has 11 single-group failures. Data-scale benefit appears mainly in single-fact groups and cross-source expression; it is consistent with increased coverage but the mechanism is not isolated. B-small fact/token exposure is not lower, so equal effective learning is not established.
